name: campus-intake
description: File-first setup - hand the campus what you already have and it configures itself. Reads everything the owner drops into inputs/intake/ (docs, exports, spreadsheets, an AI-memory dump) plus any links they share, builds the shared context files from it, plays back what it learned for correction, and interviews ONLY for the gaps. Use when the owner says "/campus-intake", "here are my files", "configure this from my documents", "I dropped files in", or asks to set up from existing material instead of an interview. Additive to /full-onboarding, never a replacement - the interview path is untouched. Resumable and non-destructive. Founding path C hands here.
